Faculty Positions Available

IMSc invites applications for regular faculty positions as Fellow and Reader in the areas of :

  1. Pure Mathematics
  2. Theoretical Physics, particularly quantum matter and information
  3. Theoretical Computer Science, also including theory of cryptography, theoretical foundations of AI/ML, and mathematical aspects of quantum computing, and
  4. Computational Biology
